newsitem.title: FINLAND: SAK SUPPORTS FINNISH PAPER WORKERS' UNION DEMANDS.
newsitem.headline: SAK SUPPORTS FINNISH PAPER WORKERS' UNION DEMANDS.

text.p: The Central Organisation of Finnish Trade Unions (SAK) said on Tuesday it supported the Paper Workers' Union's demands that the general industry labour market agreement should apply to Suomen Kerta Oy employees.
"General agreements should be respected as they are the cornerstone of the collective bargaining system," SAK said in a statement.
"SAK gives its support to the Paper Workers' Union and its efforts to find a solution to end the strikes on the basis of the (paper) industry's labour market agreement," it said.
The paper union is demanding that the 40 workers at paper napkins, plates and cups manufacturer Suomen Kerta be covered by the branch agreement.
The employer side, which does not belong to the employer confederation, wants a local agreement.
Suomen Kerta workers are on strike and workers at nearby Enso Oy plants have started support strikes.
Mediation in the conflict was scheduled to continue on Tuesday.
